## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
# ============================================================
# OSMP Palestinian Territories Scraper (Stable Version)
# No Selenium, No Chromote, No REST
# ============================================================

# Install packages if needed
pkgs <- c("rvest","xml2","dplyr","purrr","stringr",
          "tibble","tidyr","janitor","writexl")
to_install <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"]]
if(length(to_install)>0) install.packages(to_install)

library(rvest)
library(xml2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(janitor)
library(writexl)

BASE_LOCATION_URL <- "https://osmp.ngo/location/palestine/"
BASE_DOMAIN <- "https://osmp.ngo"

# -----------------------------
# STEP 1: Extract OSMP IDs from paginated location pages
# -----------------------------
page <- 1
all_ids <- character()

repeat {

  page_url <- if(page == 1) {
    BASE_LOCATION_URL
  } else {
    paste0(BASE_LOCATION_URL, "page/", page, "/")
  }

  message("Reading page: ", page_url)

  doc <- tryCatch(read_html(page_url), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(doc)) break

  page_text <- html_text(doc)

  # Extract patterns like OSMP 706 or osmp706
  ids_found <- str_extract_all(page_text, "(?i)OSMP\\s*\\d+")[[1]]

  if(length(ids_found) == 0) break

  ids_clean <- str_extract(ids_found, "\\d+")
  new_ids <- setdiff(ids_clean, all_ids)

  if(length(new_ids) == 0) break

  all_ids <- unique(c(all_ids, new_ids))

  message("  Total IDs collected: ", length(all_ids))

  page <- page + 1
}

if(length(all_ids) == 0) {
  stop("No OSMP IDs detected from location pages.")
}

message("Total OSMP entries detected: ", length(all_ids))

# -----------------------------
# STEP 2: Build OSMP URLs
# -----------------------------
osmp_urls <- paste0(BASE_DOMAIN, "/osmp", all_ids, "/")

# -----------------------------
# STEP 3: Scrape each OSMP detail page
# -----------------------------
parse_osmp_page <- function(url) {

  message("Scraping: ", url)

  doc <- tryCatch(read_html(url), error=function(e) NULL)
  if(is.null(doc)) return(NULL)

  h4_nodes <- html_elements(doc, "h4")

  result <- list(osmp_url = url)

  for(i in seq_along(h4_nodes)) {

    label <- html_text2(h4_nodes[i], trim=TRUE)
    label_clean <- make_clean_names(label)

    sibs <- xml_find_all(h4_nodes[i], "following-sibling::*")
    next_h4 <- which(xml_name(sibs) == "h4")[1]

    if(!is.na(next_h4) && next_h4 > 1) {
      sibs <- sibs[1:(next_h4-1)]
    }

    value <- paste(html_text2(sibs, trim=TRUE), collapse=" ") %>%
      str_squish()

    result[[paste0("field__", label_clean)]] <- value
  }

  as_tibble(result)
}

all_data <- map_dfr(osmp_urls, parse_osmp_page) %>%
  clean_names()

# -----------------------------
# STEP 4: Actor Attribution
# -----------------------------
ISRAEL_KEYWORDS <- c(
  "idf","israel","israeli","jdam","gbu-31",
  "gbu-32","gbu-38","mk 84","spice","harop",
  "skystriker","spike firefly"
)

PALESTINIAN_KEYWORDS <- c(
  "qassam","fajr","grad","kheibar",
  "m-302","fateh","iranian"
)

all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    text_blob = tolower(paste(across(starts_with("field__")), collapse=" ")),
    actor_vs_target = case_when(
      str_detect(text_blob, str_c(ISRAEL_KEYWORDS, collapse="|")) ~
        "Israel attacking Palestine",
      str_detect(text_blob, str_c(PALESTINIAN_KEYWORDS, collapse="|")) ~
        "Palestine attacking Israel",
      TRUE ~ "Uncertain"
    ),
    attribution_confidence = ifelse(
      actor_vs_target == "Uncertain","Low","Medium"
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
# STEP 5: Export Excel
# -----------------------------
write_xlsx(
  list(OSMP_Records = all_data),
  "osmp_palestinian_territories_full_export.xlsx"
)

message("Done. Export complete.")
```
